title: Hand-Rolled DTO Assembler Envy
pattern: An assembler class copies values field-by-field from one data holder to another parallel structure, exhibiting intense interest in the internal representations of both types.
why_bad: It leads to duplication and tight coupling between the domain class and the DTO representation. This mapping code is highly repetitive and fragile.
detection: An assembler class that contains no business logic other than mapping fields directly between two structurally identical hierarchies.
counterexample: `Context-dependent`. Centralized serializers that must handle complex protocol transformations or dynamic format versioning.
source: Martin Fowler, *Patterns of Enterprise Application Architecture* (2002), "Data Transfer Object".
